title: Industrial Warehouse Zone Sanitization
description: You are managing an automated inventory grid where sensors monitor various storage zones. If any sensor detects a structural hazard (represented by the value 0), safety protocols dictate that the entire row and column intersecting that sensor must be immediately cleared and set to 0. You must perform this update efficiently with minimal extra memory.
input_format: An m x n integer matrix representing the warehouse zone statuses.
output_format: Modify the matrix in-place such that if an element is 0, its entire row and column are set to 0.

examples.explanation: The 0 at the center causes the entire middle row and middle column to become 0.
Zeros at (0,0) and (0,3) trigger multiple row and column updates.
No zeros present, matrix remains unchanged.
